# Connector support

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Every data source listed in Lumen's **Get Data** dialog, with the Power Query M function its queries use, how it authenticates, what it folds to the source and what **Cancel** in the **Refresh** dialog does to a request that is running.

> [!NOTE]
> This page is generated from the Get data connector list in the code (`src/renderer/src/dialogs/getdata/GetDataDialog.tsx`) and checked against the M engine. Regenerate it with `npx vitest run --config scripts/docs/gen-dax-m-connector.vitest.config.ts gen-connector-support`.

## Folding, cancel and notes

| Connector | Folding | Refresh cancel | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Excel workbook | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; a file read in progress completes | .xlsx and .xlsm. Sheets and Excel tables. |
| Text/CSV | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; a file read in progress completes | .csv, .txt, .tsv, .prn; delimiter and headers detected. |
| JSON | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; a file read in progress completes | Arrays of records become tables. |
| Parquet | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; a file read in progress completes | Column types come from the file. |
| Folder | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; a file read in progress completes | Lists files with their attributes; combine them in Power Query. |
| Network share (SMB / NFS) | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; a file read in progress completes | SMB / NFS shares mounted on the computer; queries keep the smb:// address. |
| Lakehouse folder (Delta) | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; a file read in progress completes | Delta tables under Tables/ and the Files/ folder. Deletion vectors are refused. |
| SQL Server database | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, joins within one database | Yes: the request is stopped | Import or DirectQuery. DirectQuery tables load no rows. Optional native SQL statement. Windows authentication is not available. |
| PostgreSQL database | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, joins within one database | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; the request finishes in the background | Import only. Optional native SQL statement. |
| MySQL database | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, inner / left / right joins | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; the request finishes in the background | Also MariaDB. Import only. |
| SQLite database | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, inner / left joins | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; the request finishes in the background | Lumen connector. The file is read into memory, read-only. |
| DuckDB database | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, joins within one database | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; the request finishes in the background | Lumen connector. A .duckdb file (read-only) or a lakehouse folder whose Delta tables become views. |
| SQL analytics endpoint | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, joins within one database | Yes: the request is stopped | Import or DirectQuery. DirectQuery tables load no rows. Optional native SQL statement. Windows authentication is not available. |
| Warehouse | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, joins within one database | Yes: the request is stopped | Import or DirectQuery. DirectQuery tables load no rows. Optional native SQL statement. Windows authentication is not available. |
| Power BI semantic models | Not available | Not applicable | Shown but not available. |
| Dataflows | Not available | Not applicable | Shown but not available. PowerBI.Dataflows raises an error that suggests reading the dataflow destination instead. |
| Azure SQL database | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, joins within one database | Yes: the request is stopped | Import or DirectQuery. DirectQuery tables load no rows. Optional native SQL statement. Windows authentication is not available. |
| Azure Synapse Analytics SQL | Column selection, row filters, sort, skip, top N, joins within one database | Yes: the request is stopped | Import or DirectQuery. DirectQuery tables load no rows. Optional native SQL statement. Windows authentication is not available. |
| SharePoint Online list | Not available | Not applicable | Shown but not available. SharePoint.Tables raises an error. |
| Google Firestore | Field filters (=, <, <=, >, >=, in, OR, not null), top N, some sorts | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; the request finishes in the background | Lumen connector. Documents become rows; nested maps are flattened. |
| Amazon S3 / S3-compatible storage | None | Partly: Lumen stops waiting; the request finishes in the background | Lumen connector. AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2 and other S3-compatible services. Lists objects like Folder. |
| Web | None | Yes: the request is stopped | CSV, text and JSON resources. HTML pages are not supported. |
| OData feed | None | Yes: the request is stopped | OData v4 JSON; follows next links. |
| GraphQL API | None | Yes: the request is stopped | Generates a standard M query (POST). |
| REST API (paged) | None | Yes: the request is stopped | Generates a standard M paging query (page number, offset / limit, next link). |
| Enter data | None | Not applicable | Rows are stored in the query itself. |
| Blank query | Depends on the query | Not applicable | Opens a new query in the Power Query editor. |

## What the columns mean

- **Folding**: the Power Query steps Lumen turns into the source's own query language instead of running them in Lumen. Folding only continues while each step can be folded; see [Query folding](../connect-and-transform/query-folding.md).
- **Refresh cancel**: *Yes* means Lumen tells the source or the network stack to stop. *Partly* means the **Refresh** dialog stops at once and the table keeps its previous data, but the database query, object download or file read that was already running is not interrupted; its result is discarded. See [Refresh data](../connect-and-transform/refresh-data.md).
- **Lumen connector**: a connector Power BI Desktop does not have. A query that uses it does not refresh in Power BI Desktop.

## Connectors that are not exercised for this documentation

The database and cloud connectors are covered by Lumen's integration tests, which run against Docker containers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MinIO for S3, the Firestore emulator) when `LUMEN_IT=1` is set. SQL Server, Azure SQL, Fabric and Synapse have no live test. The how-to articles for these connectors are written from the code and the tests and say so.
